Title: LSJ, Jerry, What vampires are eligible for movement, ready, controlled, uncontrolled?

Messages.Author: Matt
Messages.Body:
The card text on Jerry says

Chicago Circle : During your master phase, you may move any amount of
blood from the Blood Brothers in the Chicago Circle to any other Blood
Brothers in this circle. Sterile.

I'm assuming this only functions once Jerry is ready. Can you then
move blood freely from controlled vampires to uncontrolled vampires?
And vice versa?

So on turn one you bring out Tom. On turn two you bring out Jerry.
Turn three turn you transfer all his and Tom's blood to other chicago
vampires, and bring out 2 more chicago vamps on turn 3. Turn four you
transfer from these two new ones to bring out 2 more. From turn 5 on,
you transer 2 blood to a duplicate Jerry vampire in your uncontrolled
to profit 2 per turn when you transfer that back to your pool.

As much as I would love to do this I assume this is not the case.

Going back and looking at other vampires that used to say, move from
these vamps to these vamps they all now say move to these ready vamps.
If it is meant to target unctrolled vampires it always says so, as
far as I can tell.

Wisefool
Mercuriel

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <589ebf00.01121...@posting.google.com>, Matt

<mathi...@hotmail.com> writes:
>The card text on Jerry says
>
>Chicago Circle : During your master phase, you may move any amount of
>blood from the Blood Brothers in the Chicago Circle to any other Blood
>Brothers in this circle. Sterile.

The text only functions when Jerry is ready, as with any other card.

It also functions under [1.6.1.5]:

Targets: If a card is played on another card, or selects or
chooses or otherwise targets another card, the target card must
be controlled. Vampires in the torpor region are eligible
targets by default, but vampires in the uncontrolled region and
contested cards are not.

Explicit card text is needed to over-rule this.
